name: Okta
description: Connect your own Okta org (API Token or OAuth2 Service App) to manage Users, Groups, Applications, MFA Factors, Policies, admin Roles and Sessions, plus stream the System Log for security/audit visibility.

tools.name: connect_okta
tools.description: Connect an Okta org via API Token or OAuth2 Service App, after verifying connectivity.

api_token.description: SSWS API Token (required for api_token mode).
api_token.title: Api Token

client_id.description: OAuth2 Service App client ID (required for oauth2_service_app mode).
client_id.title: Client Id

private_key.description: OAuth2 Service App private key PEM (required for oauth2_service_app mode).
private_key.title: Private Key

tools.name: disconnect_okta
tools.description: Disconnect an Okta org: deletes the saved token/credentials. Nothing in Okta itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved Okta org connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Okta orgs.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List Okta users, optionally filtered by status or search text.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status_filter.description: Optional status filter: ACTIVE, STAGED, SUSPENDED, DEPROVISIONED, etc.
status_filter.title: Status Filter

q.description: Optional search string matching name/email prefix.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Read one Okta user in full by id or login.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Create a new Okta user with profile fields, optionally activating them immediately.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

email.description: User's primary email (also used as login unless login is set).
email.title: Email

activate.description: Activate the user immediately (sends activation email unless password set).
activate.title: Activate

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Update selected profile fields of an existing Okta user.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: activate_user
tools.description: Activate a STAGED Okta user (sends activation email unless password already set).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: suspend_user
tools.description: Suspend an active Okta user, blocking their sign-in.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: unsuspend_user
tools.description: Unsuspend a suspended Okta user, restoring their sign-in access.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: deactivate_user
tools.description: Deactivate (soft-delete) an Okta user. Okta keeps a 30-day recovery window internally.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: unlock_user
tools.description: Unlock a locked-out Okta user.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: expire_user_password
tools.description: Expire an Okta user's password, forcing them to set a new one at next login.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List Okta groups, optionally filtered by search text.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

q.description: Optional search string matching group name prefix.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Read one Okta group in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a new Okta group.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_group_members
tools.description: List the members of an Okta group.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: add_user_to_group
tools.description: Add a user to an Okta group.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: remove_user_from_group
tools.description: Remove a user from an Okta group.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List Okta applications, optionally filtered by search text.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

q.description: Optional search string matching app label prefix.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Read one Okta application in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: assign_user_to_app
tools.description: Assign an Okta user directly to an application.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: assign_group_to_app
tools.description: Assign an Okta group to an application (all group members get access).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: activate_app
tools.description: Activate an Okta application.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: deactivate_app
tools.description: Deactivate an Okta application.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_user_factors
tools.description: List MFA factors enrolled for an Okta user.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: reset_user_factors
tools.description: Reset ALL enrolled MFA factors for an Okta user -- they must re-enroll at next login. Use when a user has lost their MFA device.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_policies
tools.description: List Okta policies of a given type (sign-on, password, MFA enrollment, access).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

policy_type.description: Policy type: OKTA_SIGN_ON, PASSWORD, MFA_ENROLL, ACCESS_POLICY.
policy_type.title: Policy Type

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Read one Okta policy in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_admin_roles
tools.description: List admin roles assigned to an Okta user.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: assign_admin_role
tools.description: Assign an admin role to an Okta user (e.g. SUPER_ADMIN, ORG_ADMIN, APP_ADMIN).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: remove_admin_role
tools.description: Remove an admin role assignment from an Okta user.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_system_log
tools.description: List Okta System Log events (audit trail of logins, MFA, admin actions), optionally filtered by time range or SCIM-style filter expression.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

filter_expr.description: Okta System Log SCIM-style filter expression, e.g. "eventType eq \"user.session.start\"".
filter_expr.title: Filter Expr

tools.name: audit_org
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report for the connected Okta org: active/suspended user counts, admin count, and recent failed logins.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Okta org connection ID. Omit to use the first connected org.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: okta_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Okta orgs and encrypted credentials. Managed only through connect_okta and disconnect_okta.
